_comment: Category per brand, assigned by Agent 0 (Intake) from visiting the site. Agent -1 reads this to fill the `category` column in targets.csv. Only `skincare` may enter the skincare hook corpus (docs/DESIGN.md §4) — that corpus is the compounding asset and mixing a showerhead or a silk pillowcase into it destroys what makes it valuable. Brands with no intake yet default to `unverified`: they surfaced via skincare keyword searches so they are probably skincare, but nobody has looked.
_note_granularity: Brand-level category is coarser than Agent 2's ad-level product_class. A brand tagged `skincare` can still run mostly off-category ads: Miner found SpoiledChild advertising ingestible collagen and appetite suppression, and Saltair advertising body wash and fragrance. The skincare hook corpus needs BOTH gates — this one to pick brands, and Agent 2's product_class to drop individual ads.
_note_spoiledchild: Sells topical face serums (S33+, T31, O36+) alongside ingestible collagen and magnesium. Stays `skincare` because the topical line is real, but a majority of its ADS are ingestible — Agent 2's ad-level gate is what keeps those out of the corpus, not this field.
